name: The Rittenhouse
positioning: Independent luxury hotel on Rittenhouse Square in Philadelphia's Center City, with rooms facing the square or the city
best_for: Travelers who want a base right on Rittenhouse Square
Guests who enjoy a classic hotel bar and restaurant without leaving the building
Families or longer stays wanting a suite with a kitchenette
Travelers bringing a pet who book a pet-friendly suite

facts.text: The Rittenhouse is at 210 West Rittenhouse Square in Philadelphia.
The hotel has an atrium pool and a spa.
The Rittenhouse Spa and Club has an indoor pool, an outdoor sun deck, a fitness center and a full-service spa and salon.
Lacroix, the hotel's restaurant, has been a fixture on Rittenhouse Square for over two decades.
Lacroix blends French bistro influence with global flavors and has a curated wine cellar.
The Library Bar, just off the lobby, serves classic cocktails, rare spirits and small plates.
In-room dining serves dishes from Lacroix.
Rooms have marble bathrooms with Acqua Di Parma bath amenities.
Rooms get twice-daily housekeeping, including evening turndown service.
The hotel has over 12,000 square feet of event space for meetings, weddings and social gatherings.

highlights.text: The Library Bar is book-lined, with a curated collection of fine and rare books about Philadelphia, from its past to its creative present.
The building's cantilevered facade was designed to give as many rooms as possible park views, which creates pointed corner nooks.
Each room overlooks either Rittenhouse Square or the city.
Specialty Suites have one or two bedrooms, entertainment and dining areas, and a kitchenette.

considerations.text: Not all rooms have king-size beds, so check the bed type before booking.
Rooms face either Rittenhouse Square or the city, so a park view depends on the room type booked.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
